description:
Start with 00_SGA_EN_CUMULATIVE_LINKED_READER.pdf: two navigation frontmatter pages followed by 4,209 component pages (4,211 pages total) in the internally and cross-volume linked English reader spanning SGA 1, 2, 3, 4, 4½, 5, 6, 7 I, and 7 II.

Nine standalone English component readers are direct files. Exact coverage is frozen in COMPONENT_COVERAGE.tsv: SGA 7 I is complete as published (Exposés I, II, VI-IX; Grothendieck's oral I-V were summarized in written Exposé I, with no separately written III-V); SGA 6 retains mixed source-alignment status. Editable source closures and exhaustive translation, typesetting, correction, reference-graph, build, validation, and provenance records are bundled in two audit ZIPs.

This is exactly one evolving whole-SGA English DOI lineage: no per-volume, per-exposé, or component DOI. It is the English-language component of the stable global SGA hub 10.5281/zenodo.20410947.

Stable English DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21925497. Exact release DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22551421.

This is an auditable working mathematical edition, not peer review or a claim that no error remains. No blanket license is asserted over third-party source texts; see the rights and provenance archive.

SGA2 English refresh 2026-09-06: 185-page SGA2 and 4,211-page cumulative readers. Eight other English readers and source archives, including the accepted SGA4 refresh, and French fr.zip are inherited unchanged. No whole-SGA Canon-completion claim. Current QA: hub PACKAGE_VALIDATION.json. Matching GitHub release: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/sga-en/releases/tag/v2026-09-06-sga2-r1.
notes: Exactly one evolving English-SGA DOI lineage (10.5281/zenodo.21925497). No per-volume, per-exposé, or component DOI.
